headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger’s test is generally not recommended when fewer than 10 studies are available.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 2 studies yielded an effect size of 1.1 (95% CI: 0.36–3.34), indicating no statistically significant association between coenzyme_q10 and breast cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential positive relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 91.57%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
